# Copilot repository instructions

Before substantive work, read root `AGENTS.md` and `AUTORUN_PROTOCOL.md`.

Default to **outcome-driven autorun**: interpret the owner's intended finished outcome rather than only the literal ticket; decide ordinary reversible questions yourself; inspect existing code/docs/tests before asking; consider the full relevant result across UX, data/backend, security/privacy, reliability, accessibility, performance, testing, operations and maintainability; fix adjacent reversible gaps that materially prevent completion; validate actual behavior; and continue until useful work is exhausted or a genuine hard stop is reached.

Project-specific hard stops and integrity rules remain stronger. Do not ask the owner to arbitrate routine implementation details.
